# Go1

> > Go1 is an AI-powered learning and development platform that aggregates content from 250+ education providers and delivers personalized training through intelligent agents and integrations.

Go1 provides enterprise L&D solutions with AI-driven content curation, learning management, and workplace integrations. The platform serves global organizations across multiple regions with multilingual support and comprehensive analytics to measure training ROI.

## Key Topics

- AI-powered learning
- Content aggregation
- Morgan (intelligent agent)
- Learning management system
- Employee engagement
- L&D ROI tracking
- Slack and Teams integration
- Compliance training
- Content curation
- Learning analytics
- Enterprise learning platform
- Workforce development
- Personalized learning paths
- Global learning solutions

## Core Products

- [Go1 Platform](https://www.go1.com): Go1 homepage: AI-powered L&D platform aggregating 250+ education providers
- [Morgan - Intelligent Learning Agent](https://www.go1.com/product/morgan): Morgan: Go1's intelligent agent integrating learning into Slack and Teams
- [Content Aggregator](https://www.go1.com/product/content-aggregator): Go1 content aggregator: access training from 250 leading education providers
- [AI-Powered Content Curation](https://www.go1.com/product/content-curation): Go1 AI-powered content curation: find and organize training content intelligently
- [Reporting & Insights](https://www.go1.com/product/reporting-insights): Go1 reporting & insights: track training impact and prove L&D ROI
